name: Airwallex
summary: Reads an Airwallex wallet's cash balances and their history into Banking, read-only: each money account whose identifier is a currency of the wallet is fed hourly, and Airwallex's webhooks prompt an early sync.

capabilities.trigger_rule: The sync schedule: the tick's hourly bank.sync, or an early sync a verified Airwallex webhook prompts.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: The Client ID of the scoped API key, as the Airwallex web app shows it.

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Airwallex's production, or its sandbox for staging.

history_days.title: History on the first sync
history_days.description: How many days before today the first sync reads.

secrets.name: api_key
secrets.title: API key
secrets.description: A scoped API key with Read on Balances and nothing else (Settings › Developer › API keys).

secrets.name: webhook_secret
secrets.title: Webhook secret
secrets.description: The secret of the notification URL Fyniq shows for this connector, which signs Airwallex's webhooks.

health_check: Counts Airwallex's refusals and failed connections in recent syncs, and each feed's last sync and why it stopped.
test_action: Lists the wallet's cash balances by currency, and reports whether Airwallex accepted the key.
local_substitute: A fake Airwallex in tests; Prism serves contracts/partners/airwallex.yaml in the local partners profile.
